meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Balance sheets of the co-operative banks and credit societies, tier by tier (state, district, urban, agricultural and rural development banks, credit societies), each year since 2007-08
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1214 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Amounts in ₹ crore. The mirror files these balance sheets of co-operative banks and credit societies under the title 'Growth Rate of Select Balance Sheet Indicators of Scheduled UCBs' (1214) and again under 'Select Balance Sheet Indicators of PACS' (1215); the rows are identical and are balance-sheet amounts in ₹ crore for every co-operative tier.
